description: The other half of `a-link-a-theme-gave-every-mark`, which cannot be a row beside it because a configuration is chart-level: a chart with no link anywhere — no `href` channel, none on the mark, none in the theme — draws no `cursor` at all. `cursor` returns `markDef.cursor`, which is nothing, and the property is never written. A rule that reached for the pointer on the strength of the theme alone would put one on every chart that has a `config.mark` block of any kind, which is most of them.
